phase: Phase 4 — Reliable AI generation and history UX
currentTask: Harden persisted storage paths, history/settings validation, and crash recovery around full AI regeneration.
lastKnownBlocker: A crash during the pre-commit backup phase could move old scene files into a transaction directory before commit.started existed, risking data loss on recovery.
fixApplied: Pre-commit backups are now restored before cleanup, timeline keys and source-photo filenames are canonically validated, history invariants apply on read/write, persisted ComfyUI settings are bounded and revalidated, and invalid saved settings remain editable with a visible warning.
next: Continue auditing crash windows in private media transactions
Keep invalid persisted state recoverable instead of deleting user data automatically
Preserve deterministic ComfyUI output selection and atomic full-regeneration guarantees
